notes.title: Feature Update: Steam Workshop is Live!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Shell users![/p][p]The highlight of this update is that [b]Steam Workshop is officially live[/b]!
You can now upload your custom character models, settings, and voices to the Workshop and share them with other players. This is an important step we’ve been looking forward to, and we can’t wait to see the community’s creativity shine.[/p][p]Other improvements in this update include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Graphics enhancement[/b]: Added Anti-Aliasing for smoother visuals.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Model replacement[/b]: Easier character model swapping support.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customization[/b]: Improved editing for character settings and voices.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Startup optimization[/b]: Removed api_v2.bat usage to avoid false antivirus alerts.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Known Issues[/h3][p]We are aware that when importing certain [b]VRM models[/b], hair may behave abnormally, such as floating upwards. This issue is complex due to skeleton and physics compatibility, and we are still working on a fix.
If players discover any temporary workarounds, please feel free to share them in the community discussions to help others.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support and feedback—we will keep working hard to make [b]Persona Shell[/b] an even better experience![/p]

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Feature Updates
notes.content: [h3]Update Announcement[/h3][p]This minor update includes the following changes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Backward support for VRM version 0.x models[/b]: Improved compatibility so older models can now be used properly in the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed an issue when creating characters with empty fields[/b]: Prevents errors caused by incomplete input.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Simplified weather query settings[/b]: You can now find and adjust the weather service provider directly in the Settings menu, making the process more straightforward.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We will keep improving the overall game experience.[/p]

notes.title: Feature Update
notes.content:
[h3]Multi-Monitor Support[/h3][p]You can now drag the character across different monitors.
Whether you are using dual displays or an extended multi-monitor setup, Shell will follow your movement seamlessly.[/p][p][/p][h3]LM Studio Support (Advanced)[/h3][p]Advanced users can now connect [b]LM Studio’s local LLM models[/b].
You can switch your conversation backend to use a model hosted in LM Studio for a more customized offline AI experience.
Note: This feature is intended for users familiar with LM Studio setup and model management.[/p][p][/p][h3]ElevenLabs Voice Synthesis Support (Advanced)[/h3][p]Shell now supports [b]online voice synthesis via ElevenLabs[/b].
In addition to local TTS, you can use ElevenLabs to generate voice lines in a variety of styles.
This will override the default TTS system and is recommended only for users who are comfortable with API configuration.[/p]

notes.title: Feature Update
notes.content:
Let Shell help you stay on top of your schedule!

A brand new feature is here: Google Calendar integration.
Once linked from your ToDo List, Shell can access your Google Calendar events and provide timely reminders for upcoming tasks and appointments.

Whether it’s a meeting, a date, or a birthday party, Shell becomes your reliable assistant—helping you stay organized and never miss a beat.

This feature supports reminders for both today and tomorrow, and all calendar data is stored locally on your device—never uploaded to any external server, ensuring your privacy and safety.

notes.title: Feature Upgrade Update!
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
This update adds two new useful features:

[h3]Alarm Feature (Full Version Only)[/h3]
You can now set alarms for specific times, and your Shell will remind you accordingly.
Whether it's waking up, ending a break, or switching tasks, Shell's got you covered!
※ This feature is available only in the full version and not accessible in the trial version.

[h3]Memo Feature[/h3]
Have important things you don’t want Shell to forget?
Write them into the memo—like your name, birthday, or special notes—and Shell will remember them permanently.

[h2]Advanced Configuration Note[/h2]
If you need to change the LLM model being used, you can modify the Mods/LLM/Providers.json file.
This is intended for advanced users only—we do not recommend editing this file unless necessary, as it may cause unexpected issues.

notes.title: New Feature Update
notes.content:
[h1]New Feature Update: ToDo List and Reminder System Now Available[/h1]
We've added two practical new features to your AI companion: the [b]ToDo List[/b] and [b]Reminder System[/b], making your Shell an even more helpful part of your daily routine.

[h3]ToDo List[/h3]
[list]
[*] Allows you to set a due date and time for each task
[*] Your Shell will actively notify you when a task is due
[/list]
As deadlines approach, your Shell may also give timely reminders to help you stay on track

[h3]Reminder System[/h3]
[list]
[*] Set repeating reminders for important routines—like stretching or drinking water
[*] Your Shell will remind you at regular intervals, helping you build better habits
[/list]
All reminders are fully customizable to match your lifestyle

More useful features are currently in development. We’re committed to making your AI companion smarter and more helpful with every update.
Thank you for your continued support and feedback!
